policy.rule: Raw exact-number occurrences remain namespace-classified controls with zero automatic physical-evidence weight; usefulness may span any Worldshepherd domain.

information_updates.finding: OPC 10030 gives Worldshepherd a direct bridge between ISA-95 production semantics and OPC UA objects/references, useful for integrating physical assets, logical equipment, material genealogy, production schedules and shop-floor telemetry.

The manAge and NetMan manufacturing papers are historical but directly relevant to distributed/agentic manufacturing orchestration, persistent state, fault recovery and dynamic production-network coordination.
ISO/TS 30410 can inform Worldshepherd workforce planning by linking critical-position segmentation to organizational value impact rather than treating hiring as a simple headcount metric.

CVE-2025-43010 is especially relevant because it affects SAP SCM master-data infrastructure; arbitrary ABAP replacement through code injection is a direct integrity/availability risk for production and supply-chain systems.
The 04013 GMP certificate cluster is useful as current manufacturing-compliance and partner/supply-chain intelligence, even though the numeric match is only a postal code.
information_updates.claims_boundary: 04013 is an address code, not a physical quantity.
